Lucide artwork pinned to 7faf87628a1ad6175975bc595344337ce14a7db4.
Source: https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide/tree/7faf87628a1ad6175975bc595344337ce14a7db4/icons

Uses the same Lucide icon library and revision as HejjéTrac. Original SVG paths retained. White 144px PNGs are rasterized by rsvg-convert and tinted by Unity. Rekkefly currently uses custom native controls; this is an ecosystem icon library choice, not a claim about its implementation. See LICENSE.txt for ISC and Feather MIT notices. No runtime download or rasterizer dependency.

Original source SVGs live outside Assets because Unity’s SVG importer does not support currentColor. Only the rasterized Resources icons are imported. The unmodified license is also bundled in StreamingAssets/ThirdPartyNotices/Lucide.txt.
